methodology: identical 1M ordered fixture; one thread; three warmups then 31 repetitions; alternating order; fresh archive each case; setup and full scrub outside query timings; repeated fixed queries, not general SQL

queries.name: all_aggregates
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(value) AS total, AVG(value) AS mean FROM events

queries.name: broad_window
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(value) AS total, AVG(value) AS mean FROM events WHERE ts >= 250000 AND ts < 750000

queries.name: narrow_window
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(value) AS total FROM events WHERE ts >= 999000 AND ts < 1000000

queries.name: unordered_filter
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(value) AS total FROM events WHERE value >= 0

queries.name: grouped
queries.sql: SELECT device, SUM(value) AS total FROM events GROUP BY device ORDER BY device

queries.name: min_max
queries.sql: SELECT MIN(value) AS smallest, MAX(value) AS largest FROM events WHERE ts >= 500000
